## Presentations and publications

Most of my conference work is co-authored with the graduate students whose research I supervise.

### 2026

- Gautereaux, Kayla, with Ian Howell and Cary Lee. "AI and the Voice Studio: Opportunity, Ethics, and Expertise." NATS Chat, the National Association of Teachers of Singing webinar series, October 2026.
- "The Role of Artificial Intelligence in Vocology Research, Voice Pedagogy, Clinical Practice, and Scholarship." Panel, Pan American Vocology Association Symposium, October 2026.
- Gautereaux, Kayla. "AI Supported Voice Studio Portal." Microworkshop/ToolTalk, Pan American Vocology Association Symposium, 2026. Winner, Best Microworkshop/ToolTalk.
- Gautereaux, Kayla, and Emily Siar. "Evaluating the Art of Teaching Voice." Berklee VoiceCast, episode 5, July 2026.
- Elosúa Serna, Mariana, and Brian Manternach. ["The Independent Teacher: Culturally Responsive Repertoire Categories in the Voice Studio."](https://doi.org/10.53830/sing.00189) *Journal of Singing* 82, no. 3 (January/February 2026): 345–350. Builds on Elosúa Serna's 2024 MFA thesis at Boston Conservatory at Berklee, supervised by Kayla Gautereaux.

- Da Silva, Jessye, Kayla Gautereaux, and Rachel Klippel. "Listening Beyond the Binary: Gender Perception in the MT Voice Studio." NATS National Conference, July 2026.
- Nissimoff, Michal, Kayla Gautereaux, et al. "Group Free Improvisation and Performance Anxiety." Voice Foundation Symposium, Philadelphia, PA, May 2026.
- Pay, Morgan, Kayla Gautereaux, et al. "Animal Mimicry in the Voice Studio." Voice Foundation Symposium, Philadelphia, PA, May 2026.
- Meikle, Brianna, Kayla Gautereaux, et al. "Performance Anxiety and Co-Regulation in the Vocal Audition." Voice Foundation Symposium, Philadelphia, PA, May 2026.
- Fieland, Marissa, Jennifer Burks, Kayla Gautereaux, and Ian Howell. "Respiratory Coordination and Acoustic Vocal Quality of Two Opera Singers Through the 2nd and 3rd Trimesters of Pregnancy." Poster, Voice Foundation Symposium, Philadelphia, PA, May 2026.

- AI tools for learning
